title: Multi-Granularity Context-Enhanced RAG over Multimodal Knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2608.25986v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Knowledge graph (KG)-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) leverages structured knowledge to provide large language models (LLMs) with high-quality external information. Building on these works, recent studies have explored multimodal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) as knowledge bases for GraphRAG. This enables GraphRAG to integrate knowledge across multiple modalities, thereby further enhancing its performance. However, existing MMKG-based RAG methods generally follow a common pipeline in which different modalities are largely processed independently before being fused. As a result, textual context is only used to a limited extent during visual information extraction and subsequent multimodal knowledge fusion. translated_title: 多粒度上下文增强的多模态知识图谱检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 基于知识图谱（KG）的检索增强生成（RAG）利用结构化知识为大型语言模型（LLMs）提供高质量的外部信息。在这些工作的基础上，近期研究探索了将多模态知识图谱（MMKGs）作为GraphRAG的知识库，使其能够整合跨多种模态的知识，从而进一步提升性能。然而，现有的基于MMKG的RAG方法通常遵循一个共同的流程：不同模态在很大程度上先被独立处理，然后再进行融合。因此，在视觉信息提取和后续的多模态知识融合过程中，文本上下文仅被有限地利用，这在图像和文本之间造成了语义鸿沟，限制了多模态GraphRAG的性能。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，用于构建上下文增强的多模态知识图谱（CEMMKG），以更好地支持多模
tldr: 本文提出构建上下文增强多模态知识图谱（CEMMKG）的新框架，通过在视觉信息提取和多模态知识融合过程中充分利用文本上下文，弥合图像与文本之间的语义鸿沟，从而提升多模态GraphRAG的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel framework for constructing a Context-Enhanced Multimodal Knowledge Graph (CEMMKG) that leverages textual context during visual information extraction and multimodal knowledge fusion, bridging the semantic gap between images and text to improve multimodal GraphRAG performance.
